batch: Abraham cycle (Gen 12-25:18), passages cast by scene / operation-web

units.characteristics: the call: leave/go; blessing and a great name; obedient going
units.gist: NARRATIVE - 'GO from your country... I will make of you a great nation, I will BLESS you and make your NAME great... in you all families of the earth blessed' (12:2-3, the name GIVEN vs Babel's self-made name 11:4); 'so Abram WENT' - obedient departure; builds an altar, CALLS on the name of the LORD

units.characteristics: fear-driven self-protection; the half-truth that fails faith
units.gist: NARRATIVE - famine; Abram's FEAR ('say you are my SISTER, that it may go well with me... my SOUL/life shall live because of you', 12:11-13); Sarai taken to Pharaoh; God protects/plagues Pharaoh - the interior's fear and self-securing half-truth, faith faltering; God covenant-faithful despite it

units.characteristics: generosity that yields the choice; Lot choosing by sight
units.gist: NARRATIVE - strife between herdsmen; Abram's GENEROSITY - 'let there be no strife... is not the whole land before you?' - yields first choice to the younger; Lot 'LIFTED UP his eyes and SAW' the well-watered plain (choosing by sight, toward Sodom); God renews the promise to Abram after he lets go

units.characteristics: rescue; Melchizedek's blessing; refusing gain lest another claim to have enriched him
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Abram rescues Lot; MELCHIZEDEK blesses him ('BLESSED be Abram by God Most High'); Abram tithes; and REFUSES the king of Sodom's spoil - 'lest you should say, I have made Abram rich' - the interior refusing to owe its wealth to a man, trusting God as portion

units.characteristics: fear-not / God as shield; believing reckoned righteousness; the dread and the covenant cut
units.gist: GEM - 'FEAR NOT, Abram, I am your SHIELD, your reward'; the childless complaint; 'Abram BELIEVED the LORD, and he counted it to him as RIGHTEOUSNESS' (15:6, the pivot); the covenant CUT between the pieces; a deep sleep, a DREAD and great DARKNESS falling on him - faith reckoned righteous, and the covenant God swears alone

units.characteristics: impatience taking matters in hand; the despised/fleeing; the God who SEES
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Sarai's plan (Hagar as surrogate - taking the promise into own hands); Hagar conceives and DESPISES Sarai; dealt with harshly, she FLEES; the angel FINDS her by a spring, 'the LORD has listened to your affliction'; she CALLS God 'El Roi - You are a God who SEES me' - the afflicted interior seen and heard by God

units.characteristics: walk before me / be blameless; the covenant sign; new names; falling on the face and laughing
units.gist: NARRATIVE - 'WALK BEFORE ME, and be BLAMELESS'; the everlasting COVENANT and its sign (circumcision); Abram->ABRAHAM, Sarai->SARAH (new names = new identity/destiny); Abraham FELL ON HIS FACE and LAUGHED ('shall a child be born to a man 100 years old?'); Ishmael - 'O that Ishmael might live before you!'

units.characteristics: hospitality; the promise renewed; Sarah's inward laugh; is anything too hard for the LORD
units.gist: NARRATIVE - the three visitors; Abraham's eager HOSPITALITY; the promise 'Sarah shall have a son'; Sarah LAUGHED TO HERSELF ('after I am worn out... shall I have pleasure?'); 'Why did Sarah laugh?... Is anything too HARD for the LORD?'; she denies it 'for she was AFRAID' - God reads the inward laugh

units.characteristics: God discloses to his friend; bold intercession; shall not the Judge of all the earth do right
units.gist: NARRATIVE - 'shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?'; Abraham's bold INTERCESSION for Sodom - 'shall not the Judge of all the earth do JUSTICE/right?' - bargaining from 50 to 10 righteous; the interior pleading for mercy on the wicked for the sake of the righteous, in humble boldness ('I who am but dust and ashes')

units.characteristics: judgment; Lot's lingering; the backward look; the aftermath
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Sodom's wickedness; the angels rescue Lot, who LINGERS (seized by the hand in God's mercy); 'FLEE... do not look back'; Lot's WIFE LOOKED BACK and became salt (the heart still turned to what is judged); Lot's fear, the cave, the daughters - the interior clinging to the condemned

units.characteristics: the repeated fear-lie; the integrity of the heart; God restrains sin
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Abraham again 'she is my sister' (fear - 'there is no FEAR of God in this place'); Abimelech took Sarah; God: 'I know you did this in the INTEGRITY of your HEART, and I KEPT you from sinning against me'; the interior's integrity acknowledged, and God restraining sin

units.characteristics: the laughter of joy; the son sent away; God hears the boy's weeping
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Isaac born; 'God has made me LAUGH; everyone who hears will laugh with me' (Sarah's laugh turned from doubt to joy); the strife, Hagar and Ishmael SENT AWAY (Abraham's distress); the water gone, the boy WEEPS, 'God HEARD the voice of the boy'; God OPENS her eyes to a well - God hears and sees the cast-out

units.characteristics: covenant/oath between men; calling on the Everlasting God
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Abraham and Abimelech's dispute over a well resolved by COVENANT and OATH (sworn at Beersheba, 'well of the oath'); Abraham plants a tamarisk and CALLS on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God - oath-keeping and worship

units.characteristics: the test; take your son whom you love; now I know you fear God; the LORD provides
units.gist: THE PINNACLE - 'God TESTED Abraham'; 'take your son, your only son Isaac, whom you LOVE' (first 'love' in Scripture); the three-day journey, 'God will PROVIDE the lamb'; the knife raised; 'now I KNOW that you FEAR God, seeing you have not withheld your son'; the ram; 'The LORD will provide'; the oath-blessing renewed - faith/fear/love/obedience at the extremity

units.characteristics: grief and mourning; the sojourner buying a grave
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Sarah dies; Abraham MOURNS and WEEPS for her; the courteous negotiation for the cave of Machpelah - the sojourner ('I am a stranger and a sojourner among you') securing a BURIAL place, the first possession in the land being a grave - grief, and hope held in a purchased tomb

units.characteristics: the oath; prayer for guidance; steadfast love; the leading; love and comfort
units.gist: NARRATIVE - the servant's OATH; his PRAYER for a sign, 'show STEADFAST LOVE (chesed) to my master'; Rebekah's kindness at the well; 'the LORD has LED me'; worship; Rebekah's willing 'I will go'; 'Isaac LOVED her, and was COMFORTED after his mother's death' - providence, steadfast love, and the comfort of love

units.characteristics: death in fullness; gathered to his people; the son blessed
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Keturah and the other sons (sent east with gifts, Isaac the heir); Abraham dies 'in a good old age, an old man and FULL of years, and was GATHERED to his people'; Isaac his son BLESSED - the death of the man of faith, full and gathered

units.characteristics: Ishmael's genealogy (formula; the promise to Hagar kept)
units.gist: GENEALOGY - the generations of Ishmael, twelve princes; 'he BREATHED HIS LAST/died... settled over against his kinsmen' - the formula, but recording that God's promise to Hagar (a great nation, 16:10/21:18) was KEPT; thin inner-being yield, the promise-kept the note
